title: PRR-NSGA-II experiment code for dynamic multi-objective evolutionary optimization
description: Experiment code for selection-filtered predictive redeployment with bounded memory support in dynamic multi-objective evolutionary optimization. The archived GitHub release contains only the experiment scripts and minimal software metadata; manuscript files, generated figures, generated tables, and raw result files are intentionally excluded.
